biography_english:
A Bakram warrior with the Liberation Front. He was a top recruit at the famed Vanaheimr Officer's Academy. War broke out soon after he was made a knight of the realm. He remained faithful to the royal line after the war came to an end, opposing Brantyn's rule. He joined the Liberation Front upon being driven from his knightly order.
  He was slain while attempting to aid a captured comrade with {hero}.
biography_spanish:
Guerrero bakram del Frente de Liberacion. Fue un recluta destacado en la academia militar de Vanaheimr. La guerra estallo al poco tiempo de ser nombrado caballero. Tras el fin del conflicto, siguio fiel a la linea real y se opuso a Brantyn. Al ser expulsado de la orden de caballeria, se unio al Frente de Liberacion.                 
  Murio al intentar rescatar a un camarada capturado junto a {hero}.

  He later accepted an offer from {hero} to join the Order of {order}.

biography_english:
A Bakram who served in the Liberation Front. He once taught at the Mages Academy of the former Kingdom of Valeria. After opposing Brantyn's policies he was banished from Heim. He later met Cerya and became a member of the Liberation Front.
  While raiding off the coast of Krysaro he was captured by pirates. {hero} and Sir Folcurt went to his aid, but he died before they could intervene.
biography_spanish:
Bakram que sirvio en el Frente de Liberacion. Fue profesor en la Academia de Magia del antiguo Reino de Valeria. Tras oponerse a las politicas de Brantyn, fue desterrado de Heim. Luego conocio a Cerya y se unio al Frente de Liberacion.    
  Al asaltar frente a la costa de Krysaro fue capturado por piratas. {hero} y sir Folcurt acudieron en su ayuda, pero murio antes de intervenir.
